description: R.P. Sirisena v. A.A. Amarasinghe & Others R.P. Sirisena v. A.A. Amarasinghe & Others View More before Hon. L.T.B. Dehideniya, J
parties: R.P. Sirisena v. A.A. Amarasinghe & Others R.P. Sirisena v. A.A. Amarasinghe & Others View More
keywords: Provincial public service – Dismissal following disciplinary inquiry for financial fraud – Appeals to Provincial Public Service Commission and Governor – Writ of Certiorari – Jurisdiction of Provincial High Court – Meaning of “public officer” – Provincial Council as subordinate body/component of Republic – Provincial Council officers paid from public funds – Provincial public officer falling within constitutional definition of public officer – Constitutional exclusion of judicial review of appointment, transfer, dismissal and disciplinary control of public officers – Provincial devolution within unitary State.
legistation: Constitution – Articles 55(5) (as then in force), 126 and 170; Thirteenth Amendment to the Constitution. The judgment also discusses Articles 2, 17 and 154C in considering the constitutional status of Provincial Councils.
